name: Franklin
rootCause: NFT giant whale Franklin is suspected to have posted a warning on his Twitter handle @ElectionDayMad1 with text and video that his Twitter account @franklinisbored was stolen, please do not send any cryptocurrency or click on any links, and that none of the tweets from the early morning of June 9 were posted by him.
